not_found.name: Unknown
description: Unable to find the requested inquisition.

anger.name: Anger
description: Holy (or unholy) rage, granted by your patron deity, ensures that when you fight, the battle ends with a bloody victory.

::ab[Hateful Resort (Ex)]{icon=melee immediate="Once per day, after you have been hit with a melee attack, you can make a melee attack against the creature that hit you. This melee attack is at your highest attack bonus, even if you've already attacked in the round."}

::ab[Divine Anger (Ex)]{l=6 head icon=power ability="You gain the ability to *rage* like a ‹class/barbarian›. Your effective barbarian level for this ability is your inquisitor level - 3. If you have levels in barbarian, these levels stack when determining the effect of your *rage.*~~~You do not gain any rage powers from this granted power, though if you have rage powers from another class, you may use them with these rages." order=au usage="You can *rage* a number of rounds per day equal to your Wisdom bonus, plus 1 round for every inquisitor level above 4th."}

::ab[Rage (Ex)]{next icon=boost-down flavor="Text from the barbarian class." free="You can enter (or end) a *rage.* You gain a +4 morale bonus to your Strength and Constitution, as well as a +2 morale bonus on Will saves. The increase to Constitution grants you 2 hit points per Hit Dice, but these disappear when the *rage* ends and are not lost first like ‹rule/temporary hit points›." order=fp passive="While in *rage,* you take a -2 penalty to Armor Class, and you cannot use any Charisma-, Dexterity-, or Intelligence-based skills (except Acrobatics, Fly, Intimidate, and Ride) or any ability that requires patience or concentration. You are ‹misc/fatigued› after *rage* for a number of rounds equal to 2 times the number of rounds spent in the *rage.* You cannot enter a new *rage* while fatigued or ‹misc/exhausted› but can otherwise enter *rage* multiple times during a single encounter or combat. If you fall unconscious, your *rage* immediately ends, placing you in peril of death." special="Temporary increases to Constitution, such as those gained from *rage* and spells like ‹spell/bear's endurance›, do not increase the total number of rounds that a barbarian can *rage* per day. The total number of rounds of *rage* per day is renewed after resting for 8 hours, although these hours do not need to be consecutive."}

banishment.name: Banishment
description: Your devotion to your deity is matched only by your hatred for fiends. You know the rites to cast evil outsiders back to the realms from which they hail.

::ab[Righteous Awe (Su)]{icon=touch-lower ability="Whenever you make an unarmed touch attack against an evil creature, it must succeed at a Will save (DC 10 + 1/2 your inquisitor level + your Wisdom modifier) or become ‹misc/shaken› for 1d4 rounds. If the creature touched is an evil outsider, it becomes ‹misc/frightened› instead of shaken." useMod=Wisdom3}

::ab[Dismissive Touch (Sp)]{l=8 icon=touch-magic ability="You can cast ‹spell/dismissal› once per day as a spell-like ability (caster level equal to your inquisitor level) upon making a successful unarmed touch attack against an evil outsider. The DC to save against this ability increases by 2."}

black_powder.name: Black Powder
description: ::ab[Granted Powers]{icon=power-lower ability="You gain ‹feat/Exotic Weapon Proficiency› (firearms) and ‹feat/Gunsmithing› as bonus feats.~~~When you hit an arcane spellcaster or a creature that uses spell-like abilities with a firearm attack, that creature must succeed at a Fortitude saving throw. If the spellcaster fails, he takes a -4 penalty on ‹rule/concentration› checks for 1 round."}

chivalry.name: Chivalry
description: You embrace the spirit of chivalry, guarding your honor and training a noble mount.
::ab[Mount (Ex)]{icon=power head ability="This ability acts as the ‹class/cavalier› ability of the same name."}

:::ab{next icon=power l=1 action=Ability title="Mount (Ex)" special="Your bond with your mount is strong, with the two of you learning to anticipate each other's moods and moves. Should your mount die, you may find another mount to serve you after 1 week of mourning. This new mount does not gain the *link, evasion, devotion,* or *improved evasion* special abilities until the next time you gain a level."}

You gain the service of a loyal and trusty steed to carry you into battle. This mount functions as a druid's ‹sidekick/animal companion›, using your level as your effective druid level. The creature must be one that you are capable of riding and is suitable as a mount. This mount may come from the following list:

**Medium Cavaliers:** ‹companion/Axe Beak›, ‹companion/Camel›, ‹companion/Elk›, ‹companion/Giraffe›, ‹companion/Horse›, ‹companion/Giant Seahorse›, ‹companion/Giant Tortoise›, ‹companion/Zebra›; **Small Cavaliers:** ‹companion/Antelope›, ‹companion/Boar› (requires 4th level), ‹companion/Capybara›, ‹companion/Dog› (requires 4th level), ‹companion/Kangaroo›, ‹companion/Giant Gecko›, ‹companion/Pony›, ‹companion/Ram›, Reindeer (uses elk statistics), ‹companion/Stag›, ‹companion/Giant Weasel›, ‹companion/Wolf›, ‹companion/Wolfdog›
The GM might approve other animals as suitable mounts.

You do not take an armor check penalty on ‹skill/Ride› checks while riding your mount. The mount is always considered combat trained and begins play with ‹feat/Light Armor Proficiency› as a bonus feat. Your mount does not gain the *share spells* special ability.

::ab[Faithful Steed (Su)]{icon=power l8="When you use your *judgment* ability, your mount gains the benefit of one of your selected *judgments.*" l16="Your mount gains the benefits of two of your selected *judgments.*"}

clandestine.name: Clandestine
description: Secrecy is required of the faithful in lands where your deity's worshipers are hunted.
::ab[Disappear (Sp)]{icon=def standard="You can become invisible as per ‹spell/the spell»<invisibility›. The invisibility lasts for 1 round per inquisitor level or until you attack." useMod=Wisdom3}

::ab[Blessed Secrecy (Su)]{l=4 icon=roll passive="When you attempt a ‹skill/Bluff›, ‹skill/Disguise›, Sleight of Hand, or ‹skill/Stealth› skill check, you can roll twice and take the more favorable result." useMod=Wisdom}

::ab[Delayed Spells (Su)]{l=8 icon=magic ability="You can delay the effects of a spell you cast by up to 1 round per inquisitor level. You choose the duration of the delay when you cast the spell and can cause the spell to take effect immediately during the period of delay by concentrating as a @HLstandard_action." useInc=inquisitor~4~8}

conversion.name: Conversion
description: You are a powerful persuader. A honeyed tongue empowered by divine argumentation sways the indifferent and adversarial to your side.
::ab[Charm of Wisdom (Ex)]{icon=boost ability="You use your Wisdom modifier instead of your Charisma modifier when making ‹skill/Bluff›, ‹skill/Diplomacy›, and ‹skill/Intimidate› checks."}

::ab[Swaying Word (Sp)]{l=8 icon=magic ability="Once per day you may speak a word of divinely inspired wisdom that causes a single creature to switch its alliance to you. The target must be within line of sight and able to hear you. If he fails his Will save, he is affected by ‹spell/dominate person›, except the duration is only 1 minute."}

crime.name: Crime
description: Your connections to the criminal underworld run deeper than the physical, and your spiritual criminality grants you underhanded powers.

::ab[Criminal Minds (Sp)]{icon=touch ability="You can touch a creature and fill its mind with criminal impulses. This otherwise functions as per ‹spell/crime of opportunity›, though a target that fails its saving throw and acts on an impulse gets those desires out of its system and becomes immune to the effects of your *criminal minds* ability for 24 hours." useMod=Wisdom3 useM}
::ab[Thief's Soul (Ex)]{l=8 icon=power ability="You gain ‹feat/Improved Steal›, ‹feat/Greater Steal›, and ‹feat/Quick Steal› as bonus feats, even if you don't meet the prerequisites."}

damnation.name: Damnation
description: The prospect of an afterlife filled with torment can cause even the most stalwart to blanch - at least for a moment.

::ab[Fear the Flames (Su)]{icon=magic ability="You can give a creature you can see within 60 feet one chance to avoid an eternity of suffering by ordering it to carry out any one simple action that would take no more than 1 round to complete. Good and neutral creatures that refuse become ‹misc/shaken› for 1 round (Will negates), while evil creatures that obey gain a +2 morale bonus on all rolls and checks made for 1 round." useMod=Wisdom3 special="This is a language-dependent, mind-affecting effect."}

::ab[Collector of Souls (Sp)]{l=8 icon=magic standard="Once per day you call forth an illusory fiend and order it to temporarily drag a living and sentient creature into an afterlife of pain and misery. This otherwise acts identically to ‹spell/phantasmal killer›, except targets that fail their Fortitude saving throws become ‹rule/paralyzed› for a number of rounds equal to 1d4 + your inquisitor level instead of dying."}

excommunication.name: Excommunication
description: Marked by your deity for your impressive will, you are among the few with the wherewithal to carry out the necessary work of removing dangerous influences from your church.
You can repulse the influence of confused divine servants.
::ab[Touch of Silence (Su)]{icon=touch ability="With a melee touch attack, you render a target silent (as the spell ‹spell/silence›, but only affecting the target) for 1 round." useMod=Wisdom3}

::ab[Excommunicate (Su)]{l=8 icon=lower standard="Once per day, you can silence a creature within 30 feet. A Will save against DC = 10 + 1/2 your inquisitor level + your Wisdom modifier negates the effect. A creature that fails its save gets a second save 1 round later. If it fails the second save, the target cannot speak, provide verbal components for spells, make use of language-dependent effects, write, pantomime, or take any other action meant to communicate anything more complex than a simple affirmative or negative for 1 day."}

execution.name: Execution
description: Your deity guides you when you deliver death to your chosen targets.

::ab[Chosen Victim (Sp)]{icon=boost ability="Once per day, you can designate a creature as your *chosen victim.* You gain a +2 bonus on ‹skill/Diplomacy› checks to gather information about your target, on ‹skill/Bluff› and ‹skill/Intimidate› checks against your target, and on ‹skill/Survival› checks to track your target. The benefits of your *destruction, piercing, purity,* and *smiting judgments* against your *chosen victim* increase as if your inquisitor level were 3 higher."}

::ab[Executioner's Strike (Su)]{l=8 icon=boost flavor="Your precision in combat has become incredible, and you can strike a lethal blow if your target cannot defend itself properly." standard="Once per day, you can make an attack against your *chosen victim.* If the attack hits and the victim is denied its Dexterity bonus to AC against you, any critical threats are automatically confirmed."}

fate.name: Fate
description: Fate is a powerful tool for those who dole out justice for their deity. You can read the strands of fate, and those strands guide your endeavors.
::ab[Augury (Sp)]{icon=magic ability="Once per day, you can use ‹spell/augury› as a spell-like ability."}

::ab[Agent of Fate (Su)]{l=8 icon=aid-boost-def ability="When you use your *augury* spell-like ability, you gain a benefit that lasts until the end of your next combat. If the result was &quot&weal,&quot& all curing effects used on you cure an additional +1d10 hit points. If the result was &quot&woe,&quot& your melee attacks deal an additional +1d6 points of damage. If the result is &quot&weal and woe&quot& or &quot&nothing,&quot& you gain a +2 insight bonus to your Armor Class."}

fervor.name: Fervor
description: Only a passionate and righteous will such as yours can ensure that justice will be properly done.

::ab[Fire of Belief (Sp)]{icon=zap ability="You can unleash a gout of holy or unholy flame that sears one target within 30 feet as a ranged touch attack. The target takes 1d6 points of fire damage plus ‹misc/half› your inquisitor level (minimum +1).~~~If you are good, the flames only harm nongood targets. If you are evil, the flames only harm nonevil targets. If you are neither good nor evil, when you gain this ability you must decide whether the flames harm only nongood or nonevil targets; once you make this decision, it cannot be changed (though if your alignment changes, the effect of the flames changes appropriately)" useMod=Wisdom3}

::ab[Fervent Action (Ex)]{icon=power l=8 swift="Once per day you can make a single melee attack at your highest attack bonus, move up to your speed, or cast a prepared inquisitor spell (of a spell level up to one lower than the highest level spell you can cast) as per ‹feat/Quicken Spell›."}

final_rest.name: Final Rest
description: The dead have paid their dues; there is no need, and no excuse, for them to walk. You protect their rest personally.
::ab[Disrupt Animation (Sp)]{icon=magic ability="You can use ‹spell/disrupt undead› as a spell-like ability, adding your wisdom modifier to the damage." useMod=Wisdom3}

::ab[Unravel Animation (Su)]{l=8 icon=boost ability="When you activate your *bane* ability with undead as the creature type, you can choose for your weapon to instead gain the ‹magic-enh/disruption› weapon special ability. The DC to resist this effect is equal to 10 + 1/2 your inquisitor level + your Wisdom modifier."}

heresy.name: Heresy
description: Often it is hard to tell heretics from the faithful. You use duplicity, stealth, and the heretics' own arguments to root them out and bring them to justice.
::ab[Righteous Infiltration (Ex)]{icon=boost ability="You use your Wisdom modifier instead of your Charisma modifier when making ‹skill/Bluff› and ‹skill/Intimidate› checks."}
::ab[Blessed Infiltration (Ex)]{l=4 icon=roll ability="When you make a Bluff, ‹skill/Diplomacy›, or ‹skill/Stealth› check, you may roll twice and take the more favorable result." useMod=Wisdom}

::ab[Word of Anathema (Sp)]{l=8 icon=magic-lower ability="Once per day, you can speak a *word of anathema* against a single creature within 60 feet (Will negates). This acts as ‹spell/bestow curse› and lasts for 1 minute, giving the target a -4 penalty on attack rolls, saves, ability checks, and skill checks."}

illumination.name: Illumination
description: Many times an inquisitor's greatest weapon is pure and unflinching illumination; errors are often illuminated by light and wisdom.

::ab[Illuminating Touch (Sp)]{icon=protect-boost standard="You cause your hand to shimmer with divine radiance, allowing you to touch a creature and give it a bonus equal to 1/2 your inquisitor level on a single Will saving throw, ‹skill/Knowledge› check, ‹skill/Perception› check, or ‹skill/Sense Motive› check. This ability lasts for 1 hour or until the creature chooses to apply the bonus to a roll." useMod=Wisdom3}

::ab[Aura of Enlightenment (Su)]{l=4 icon=aura-boost ability="You can create a 30-foot-radius aura of normal light. Allies in this *aura* gain a +2 insight bonus on skill checks. This counts as a 2nd-level ‹spelldef/light› effect for the purpose of countering or dispelling darkness effects." useL=inquisitor useNC}

imprisonment.name: Imprisonment
description: Sometimes it is better to capture foes than to kill them - whether your intention is to punish them for their crimes or to torture them for information.

::ab[Caging Strike (Su)]{icon=lower flavor="With a devastating weapon strike, spectral chains wrap around your target for a short period of time." ability="Whenever you confirm a critical hit with a melee or ranged weapon attack (including spells that require attack rolls), you can choose to also ‹rule/entangle<d› that target for 1d4 rounds (Fortitude negates)." useMod=Wisdom3}
::ab[Divine Prison]{l=8 icon=magic ability="Once per day upon making a successful melee attack, you can affect your target with ‹spell/hold monster› (Will negates)."}

justice.name: Justice
description: Some must learn that to submit to one's fate often means submitting to your form of justice.

::ab[Judicious Force (Su)]{icon=boost immediate="If you or an ally within 10 feet makes a critical threat with a melee or ranged attack, you may add +4 to the confirmation roll. This does not stack with the ‹feat/Critical Focus› feat." useMod=Wisdom}

::ab[Chains of Justice (Su)]{l=6 icon=lower-down ability="Once per day, you can bind an opponent within 60 feet to you with spectral chains (Will negates). When you take damage from an enemy, the bound target takes this damage as well. Whenever the bound target takes damage from you or one of your allies, you take this damage as well. You and the target are not physically bound to each other, and either can end the connection by breaking the line of effect or exceeding the ability's range. You may dismiss the chains as a @HLstandard_action."}

oblivion.name: Oblivion
description: Some inquisitors believe that without faith there is only oblivion. But there are some divine servants who know enough about the darkness that lies beyond faith to use it as a tool- and a weapon.

::ab[Life Anchor (Su)]{icon=aura-aid ability="You gain a 10-foot-radius aura that helps dying creatures cling to life. Within this aura, a dying creature (including yourself) adds your Wisdom bonus to its ‹misc/stabilization« checks› (in addition to any other modifiers to stabilization checks)."}
::ab[Stare of Oblivion (Sp)]{l=8 icon=zap ability="You can use ‹spell/feeblemind› as a ‹umr/gaze› attack against one creature (Will negates). This effect lasts 1d4 rounds." useInc=inquisitor~4~8}

order.name: Order
description: Most inquisitors fight insane aberrations and demonic creatures as well as the chaos of heresy. They use the dictum and the mantles of law in order to aid their struggle.

::ab[Mantle against Chaos (Sp)]{icon=def-protect ability="You can use ‹spell/protection from chaos› on yourself or another creature as a spell-like ability." useL=inquisitor useM useUnit=minute useNC=1}
::ab[Commanding Order (Sp)]{l=8 icon=magic ability="You can use ‹spell/greater command›, except it only affects a single target." useMod=Wisdom3}

persistence.name: Persistence
description: Your deity chose you for your persistence. You have vowed to pursue the enemies of the faith to the world's end if necessary.
::ab[Step Up]{icon=power ability="You receive ‹feat/Step Up› as a bonus feat."}

::ab[Relentless Footing (Ex)]{icon=boost swift="You can add 10 feet to your land speed. This increase counts as an enhancement bonus, and it affects your ‹skill/acrobatics>«jumping› distance as normal for increased speed." useMod=Wisdom3 useM}

::ab[Inner Strength (Su)]{l=6 icon=aid swift="Once per day, you may heal yourself for 3d6 hit points. When you use this ability, you can also remove one of the following conditions from yourself: blinded, confused, dazzled, deafened, frightened, nauseated, shaken, sickened, or staggered." incrementPlain="The amount you heal~6~2~4~1" incrementEnd="d6."}

politics.name: Politics
description: Your divine guidance twists agreements, laws, and policies to suit the interests of the faith.

::ab[Labyrinthine Words (Ex)]{icon=boost passive="You add your Wisdom modifier in addition to your Charisma modifier on ‹skill/Bluff› checks to lie and ‹skill/Diplomacy› checks to influence other creatures."}

::ab[Heart's Desire (Sp)]{l=8 icon=magic flavor="You receive divine guidance on the goals of your political allies and rivals." ability="Once per day, you can use ‹spell/commune› as a spell-like ability using your inquisitor level as your caster level, but only to ask questions about others' goals."}

possession.name: Possession
description: You can invade the bodies of lesser beings and command them to bend to your will.

::ab[Self-Control (Ex)]{icon=def ability="You possess remarkable control over your own body, and gain a +2 competence bonus on saving throws made against enchantment spells of the charm or compulsion subschool."}

::ab[Beast Ride (Su)]{icon=magic l=4 standard="Once per day you can vacate your body and inhabit that of any creature belonging to the animal type within 30 feet for a number of rounds up to your inquisitor level.~~~While you are possessing an animal in this way, your own body becomes helpless and unaware. You can travel any distance from your body so long as you remain on the same plane, and can return to your own body as a @HLfree_action at any time.~~~If the animal or your body takes damage, or you attempt to make the animal attack or do anything out of character, the effect immediately ends and you return to your own body."}

::ab[Body Snatch (Sp)]{icon=magic l=10 immediate="Once per day upon falling unconscious because of dropping below 0 hit points, you can cast your soul from your body and attempt to occupy the body of another creature within 30 feet. This ability otherwise functions identically to ‹spell/magic jar› except that your actual body serves as the receptacle and you suppress the consciousness of your target rather than casting it out.~~~Your body continues to ‹misc/bleed as normal»<dying› unless it is somehow stabilized, and if its hit points drop to a negative number equal to your Constitution score, the *magic jar* effect prematurely ends and you die as normal."}

recovery.name: Recovery
description: Some hunt down secrets, but you focus on the search for more tangible items.

::ab[Focused Search (Ex)]{icon=boost ability="Once per day, you may designate a person or object as your *focus.* This takes 1 minute of concentration, during which time you must either picture this item or person if familiar to you, or meditate on the item's or person's description if not. Until you choose a new *focus,* you gain a bonus equal to half your inquisitor level on ‹skill/Perception› checks to see or hear your *focus,* or when using ‹skill/Survival› to track your *focus* or a creature with your *focus* in its possession." special="This bonus stacks with that gained from the *track* special ability."}

::ab[Locate Focus (Sp)]{l=8 icon=magic ability="Once per day you may use either ‹spell/locate creature› or ‹spell/locate object› as a spell-like ability using your current *focus* as the target. The range of this effect is 1 mile per level."}

redemption.name: Redemption
description: Your deity inspires you with hope that wayward members of your faith can be brought back into the fold.
You reach out to your misguided fellows and give them every chance to turn back from conflict with the true faith, even if your differences come to violence.
::ab[Patient Sensibility (Su)]{icon=boost passive="You gain a +2 bonus on ‹skill/Diplomacy›, ‹skill/Perception›, and ‹skill/Sense Motive› checks."}

::ab[Redeemer's Mercy (Su)]{l=4 icon=boost passive="Any weapon you wield gains the ‹magic-enh/merciful› magic weapon special ability. The weapon immediately reverts to its original abilities when you cease to wield it."}

::ab[Second Chance (Sp)]{l=8 icon=magic-aid flavor="You can give an enemy a second chance to correct the error of its ways." standard="Once per day, you can cast ‹spell/atonement› as a spell-like ability, targeting a creature that has violated the tenets of a religion you both share or that freely desires to convert to your alignment. If costly material components are required for the *atonement,* you may choose to accept a permanent ‹rule/negative level› as a sacrifice in place of those components.~~~The target of this effect also receives the benefits of a ‹spell/cure serious wounds› spell as part of the effects of the *atonement.*"}

reformation.name: Reformation
description: Moved by divine disapproval of your church's mistakes, you seek to correct them however you can.
You can speak with divine persuasiveness.

::ab[Inspired Rhetoric (Ex)]{icon=boost-skill ability="You use your Wisdom modifier in place of your Charisma modifier when making ‹skill/Diplomacy›, ‹skill/Intimidate›, and ‹skill/Perform› (oratory) checks. Perform (oratory) is an inquisitor class skill for you."}
::ab[Blessed Correction (Ex)]{l=4 icon=roll passive="When you make a Diplomacy, Intimidate, or Perform (oratory) check, you may roll twice and take the more favorable result." useMod=Wisdom}

::ab[Awaken Discontent (Su)]{l=8 icon=magic ability="You can deliver a stirring speech condemning the mistakes of those in power and calling for reform, causing the target of your rhetoric to be affected by ‹spell/charm person› with a caster level equal to your inquisitor level and a save DC of 10 + 1/2 your inquisitor level + your Wisdom modifier." useMod=Wisdom}

restoration.name: Restoration
description: You are a healer, not just of people but also of sacred sites tainted by enemies of your faith.

::ab[Mend the Broken (Su)]{icon=aid standard="You can touch an object or creature healing it of 1d4 points of damage + 1 for every 2 inquisitor levels you possess. You can use this ability only on a broken object or a creature with fewer than half its maximum hit points." useMod=Wisdom3}

::ab[Cleanse Impunity (Su)]{l=8 icon=boost choice="Choose an alignment (chaotic, evil, good, or lawful) that is opposite to one axis of your own. Once chosen, this cannot be changed." ability="Add your Wisdom bonus on caster level checks to overcome the spell resistance of creatures with the chosen alignment subtype; dispel effects with the chosen alignment descriptor; and remove curses, diseases, and poisons." order=ca special="A neutral inquisitor gains only the bonus on caster level checks to remove curses, diseases, and poisons."}

revelation.name: Revelation
description: Evil often hides itself behind a mask of good. You are an expert at ferreting out those who are not what they seem, and use your powers to reveal the true forms of the unworthy.

::ab[Burn Shroud (Su)]{icon=touch standard="You can make an unarmed touch attack against a creature. The target takes 1d4 points of fire damage + ‹misc/half› your inquisitor level (minimum 1).~~~If the target is currently the subject of a polymorph effect that changes its appearance (such as by ‹spell/alter self›, ‹spell/shapechange›, or an innate shapechanging ability such as that possessed by ‹monster/doppelganger«s›), it instead takes 1d6 points of fire damage + half your inquisitor level (minimum 1)." useMod=Wisdom3}

::ab[Reveal Form (Su)]{icon=magic-lower l=8 standard="Once per day you can invoke the name of your deity and order one shapechanged target within 30 feet to reveal its true form. The target must succeed at a Will save (DC 10 + 1/2 your inquisitor level + your Wisdom modifier) or be forced on its next turn to dispel any ongoing polymorph effects or innate shapechanging abilities to assume its natural form." special="If a creature affected by this ability fails its save and is for some reason unable to dispel any ongoing polymorph effects or innate shapechanging abilities, it is instead ‹misc/staggered› for 1 round. This is a mind-affecting compulsion effect."}

secrets.name: Secrets
description: You have learned to keep your own secrets close, and your enemies' secrets closer.

::ab[Detect Secrets (Su)]{icon=magic flavor="You have learned how to detect any of a creature's secrets, not just its thoughts." ability="Whenever you cast ‹spell/detect anxieties›, ‹spell/detect desires›, or ‹spell/detect thoughts› or use any of those spells as a spell-like ability, you can choose to gain the effects of one of the other two spells instead. You are never overwhelmed by a target of these spells that has a high ability score."}

::ab[Closed Book (Sp)]{l=8 icon=def flavor="It becomes difficult for your foes to unveil your secrets." passive="You are constantly under the effect of ‹spell/nondetection›, as if you cast the spell on yourself."}

sedition.name: Sedition
description: Your deity calls you to cast down a hostile government. Stealth is a class skill for you.

::ab[Undermine Authority (Sp)]{icon=magic useMod=Wisdom ability="You can worsen the attitude of a character toward any governmental officer or leader acting against your religion. This likewise reduces that officer's or leader's influence with that character. The persuasion requires enough conversation to attempt a ‹skill/Diplomacy› check (usually 1 minute) and you attempt a Diplomacy check as normal to influence the target's attitude. However, if you fail the check, the target is subject to a mind-affecting compulsion that alters its attitude for a number of days equal to your inquisitor level. The target can resist the compulsion with a successful Will saving throw (DC = 10 + 1/2 your inquisitor level + your Wisdom modifier). If the target is under a mind-affecting effect from that officer or leader, the effect is automatically suppressed for 1 minute."}
::ab[Rebel Leader (Ex)]{l=8 icon=power ability="You gain ‹feat/Leadership› as a bonus feat."}

seduction.name: Seduction
description: Your deity blesses your attempts to use sex and love for a higher purpose.

::ab[Disarming Flirtation (Sp)]{icon=power-lower ability="You can attempt a Charisma check to entice a target that could be sexually attracted to you into letting you speak for up to 1 minute when it would otherwise be unwilling to consider your words. The DC of this Charisma check is equal to 10 + the target's Wisdom modifier.~~~If successfully used in combat, this ability instead functions as a successful ‹skill/feint› and the target cannot take any actions that would attack you as long as it is denied its Dexterity bonus against you."}

::ab[Inspire Devotion (Ex)]{icon=power ability="By spending at least 1 hour engaged in acts of physical pleasure with a willing partner, you can attempt a ‹skill/Diplomacy› check to improve that partner's attitude or increase your influence with that partner (or reduce a rival's influence with that partner) with no maximum on the number of steps by which you can change that partner's attitude or disposition."}

sin.name: Sin
description: You know how to stoke the seven sins in others (envy, gluttony, greed, lust, pride, sloth, and wrath), and twist their dark desires to suit your own purposes.

::ab[Sin Sense (Su)]{icon=boost fullround="You can determine which sin most strongly influences a target by quickly reading its mind. Once you learn this fact, you gain a +4 bonus on your next Charisma-based skill check made against the target as long as it somehow incorporates a temptation that relates to that sin." special="This is a mind-affecting effect." useMod=Wisdom3}

::ab[Indulge (Su)]{icon=lower l=8 standard="Once per day you can awaken a creature's vice and overwhelm its senses with urgency. You must decide to use this ability before using your *sin sense* ability on a creature, and the target receives a Will save to negate the effect.~~~If the creature fails its saving throw, for the next 24 hours, whenever the affected creature is given an opportunity to indulge in its favored sin, that creature must yield to the impulse or make a second Will saving throw to avoid becoming ‹misc/sickened› for 1 minute." special="This is a mind-affecting effect."}

spellkiller.name: Spellkiller
description: ::ab[Granted Powers]{icon=power-def ability="You gain the ‹feat/Disruptive› feat as a bonus feat (even if you do not meet the prerequisites).~~~When you defeat an enemy (whether by reducing it to 0 or fewer hit points, taking the enemy captive, or accepting a truce), you gain a +2 sacred or profane bonus to AC for 1 minute per level. You gain a sacred bonus if you are good, profane if you are evil; if you are neutral, you choose either sacred or profane when you select this inquisition. After you choose which type of bonus you gain, you cannot change the bonus type.~~~When you hit a creature with levels of ‹class/alchemist› or any arcane spellcasting class, or that uses spell-like abilities, you can end this effect to ‹misc/stagger<ed› that creature. The creature gets a Fortitude saving throw against this effect on each of its turns (including the turn in which it gained the effect). A successful save ends the staggered condition."}

tactics.name: Tactics
description: It is the cold and tactical mind that often wins the day. A proper, carefully considered sacrifice can inspire one's allies to serve your cause.

::ab[Inquisitor's Direction (Su)]{icon=down-boost ability="At the start of your turn, you can choose to enter a tranquil, reflective state and forgo all actions (standard, move, swift, immediate, and free actions, including attacks of opportunity) for that round; one ally of your choice within 30 feet gains the benefit of ‹spell/haste› for 1 round." useMod=Wisdom3 useM}
::ab[Grant the Initiative (Ex)]{l=8 icon=boost passive="You and all allies within 30 feet may add your Wisdom bonus to your initiative checks."}

torture.name: Torture
description: Only through pain can truth and justice come to the surface. And if that doesn't work, at least you've enacted divine vengeance.
::ab[Torturer's Presence (Ex)]{icon=boost passive="You gain a +2 bonus when using the ‹skill/Intimidate› skill. This is in addition to your bonus for *Stern Gaze.*"}

::ab[Torturer's Touch (Sp)]{icon=magic-touch ability="You may use ‹spell/touch of fatigue› as a spell-like ability. Creatures that are immune to pain effects are immune to this touch." useMod=Wisdom3}

::ab[Critical Precision (Ex)]{l=8 icon=boost ability="When you roll a critical threat, you may expend one use of your *torturer's touch* ability to add +4 on your critical confirmation roll. This does not stack with ‹feat/Critical Focus›."}

true_death.name: True Death
description: You see undead as a perversion of the natural order, a misuse of magic, or an unjust enslavement of a departed spirit's body, and are sworn to destroying such beings.

::ab[Back to the Graves (Su)]{icon=boost ability="When you cast cure spells (any spells with ‹main/&quot&cure&quot&»<spell_groupings› in their name) to deal damage to undead creatures, you add +2 points of damage per caster level instead of +1 point of damage per caster level. The maximum damage for each spell remains unchanged."}

::ab[Hallowed Rite (Su)]{l=8 icon=protect ability="You gain the ability to conduct a sacred funeral rite. This rite takes 1 day, during which you perform the necessary chants and prayers and burn incense. At the end of the rite you must oversee the burial of the corpse. The burial must take place within 24 hours of the preparation or the ritual fails. Once the body is interred, it cannot be turned into an undead creature, as if it were under the effect of a ‹spell/hallow› spell (caster level equal to your inquisitor level)."}

truth.name: Truth
description: To find truth, one has to wring honesty from others - whether in a friendly or hostile manner.

::ab[Justice's True Path (Sp)]{icon=boost standard="You can touch a creature, granting an insight bonus on one attack roll, skill check, ability check, or saving throw before your next turn; this bonus is equal to half your inquisitor level (minimum 1) and lasts for 1 round." useMod=Wisdom3}

::ab[Grasp of Honesty (Su)]{l=8 icon=lower ability="Any creature you are grappling or pinning is affected by ‹spell/zone of truth› (Will negates). Outside of combat, you may use this ability by touching a target with both hands." useL=inquisitor useNC special="The effect ends if you stop grappling, pinning, or touching the target."}

valor.name: Valor
description: It takes courage to confront the enemies of your faith.
::ab[Touch of Resolve (Sp)]{icon=aid ability="You may use ‹spell/remove fear› on a single creature." useMod=Wisdom3}
::ab[Fearless (Su)]{l=8 icon=def passive="You become immune to fear."}

vengeance.name: Vengeance
description: Vengeance is justice naked of pretense. On your oath, you will deliver justice so unbounded.

::ab[Divine Retribution (Sp)]{icon=magic standard="You can point at one creature within 30 feet to indicate that it is the target of divine wrath. A mishap or an accident appropriate to the environment occurs, such as a branch falling on the creature, rocks falling from the ceiling, or some other nonmagical misfortune; regardless of the cause, the mishap deals damage equal to 1d6 + ‹misc/half› your inquisitor level (Reflex half)." special="The GM decides whether this damage is bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage." useMod=Wisdom3}

::ab[Final Vengeance (Su)]{l=8 icon=melee ability="Once per day, you can make one melee attack against an opponent within reach in response to an attack that would reduce you to negative hit points. Once your attack is resolved, you suffer the normal effect of the attack that provoked this ability." special="Effects that kill you or do not reduce you to negative hit points (such as ‹rule/ability damage« or» drain›, ‹rule/negative level«s›, and ‹spell/disintegrate›) do not trigger this ability."}

zeal.name: Zeal
description: An inquisitor needs unyielding zeal in order to make sure her deity's work is done.
::ab[Zealous Surge (Sp)]{icon=def passive="Once per day, when you are reduced to 0 or fewer hit points, you heal a number of hit points equal to your inquisitor level + your Wisdom modifier."}

::ab[Scourge of the Enemy (Ex)]{l=8 icon=boost-def ability="Select one religion that is a rival or opponent of your religion. You treat members of this religion as if they were your ‹ability/favored enemy› (as the ranger class ability), gaining a +2 bonus on the appropriate rolls." imp13="These bonuses become +4." imp18="These bonuses increase to +6." special="These bonuses do not stack with other favored enemy bonuses (use the highest bonus that applies)."}
